from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util, sys
runtime=Path.home()/'.local/share/prediction-chat-bridge'
sys.path.insert(0,str(runtime))
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('installed_bridge_ping_status',runtime/'bridge_server.py')
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
assert getattr(mod.Handler,'server_version','')=='PredictionChatWake/1.1-bridge-ping-status'
raw='\n'.join(['RESULT_READY: BRIDGE-PING-RUNTIME-E001','Action: BRIDGE_PING','Exit code: 0','=== WSL RESULT ===','BRIDGE_PONG'])
msg=mod.compact_delivery_event({'event_id':'runtime-e014','task_id':'BRIDGE-PING-RUNTIME-E001','message':raw})['message']
assert 'status=PASS' in msg and 'exit=0' in msg, msg
unknown='\n'.join(['RESULT_READY: OTHER-E001','Exit code: 0','=== WSL RESULT ===','OTHER_OUTPUT'])
unknown_msg=mod.compact_delivery_event({'event_id':'runtime-e014-u','task_id':'OTHER-E001','message':unknown})['message']
assert 'status=UNKNOWN' in unknown_msg, unknown_msg
dev='\n'.join(['RESULT_READY: DEV-OUTER-E001','Exit code: 0','=== WSL RESULT ===','DEV_TASK_STATUS=FAIL','ERROR_CLASS=OldFailure','COMMAND_1_RC=2','COMMAND_1_RC=0','DEV_TASK_STATUS=PASS'])
dev_msg=mod.compact_delivery_event({'event_id':'runtime-e014-d','task_id':'DEV-OUTER-E001','message':dev})['message']
assert 'status=PASS' in dev_msg and 'rcs=1:0' in dev_msg and 'error=' not in dev_msg, dev_msg
assert getattr(mod.session.Handler,'server_version','')=='PredictionChatWake/0.9-session-bootstrap'
assert callable(getattr(mod.session,'ensure_session_bootstrap',None))
print('BRIDGE_PING_STATUS_E014=PASS')
print('HANDLER_VERSION='+mod.Handler.server_version)
print('PING_COMPACTED='+msg)
print('DEV_COMPACTED='+dev_msg)
